svg.title: My skill sky: what I know, drawn as constellations
svg.desc: The Backend: Python, Flask, REST / JSON, pytest, Gunicorn, Docker; The Renderer: three.js, WebGL2, GLSL, JavaScript, HDR bloom, HTML / CSS; The Automaton: GitHub Actions, Playwright, CI checks, AI / MCP APIs, CodeQL; The Astrolabe: Zodiac math, Ephemerides, Kepler orbits, PyEphem checks, Real star catalogue

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: WHAT I KNOW · DRAWN AS CONSTELLATIONS

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Bigger star = I reach for it more. Lines = things I use together.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
